summary: Integer Holdings filed an 8-K disclosing stockholder litigation against its pending take-private merger with KKR affiliates Armstrong Parent and Merger Sub, announced August 2, 2026. Three New York state suits (Delman, Kent, Walsh) name the company and its board, alleging the definitive proxy filed September 14, 2026 omits or misstates material merger information and seeking to enjoin closing. A special meeting to approve the merger is set for October 21, 2026. Thirteen additional demand letters were reportedly received. Filing discloses no price, premium, or outside date. Watch for supplemental proxy disclosures, adjournment risk, and injunction rulings ahead of the vote.
